integrity: The primary source was inspected at its logarithmic convexity, Lelong-slope formula, exact spherical-solid identity, and radial-regularization proof. The new result keeps the nonzero asymptotic slope in the same radial averaging representation and applies a quantified dominated-convergence argument. The earlier VMO paper was compared at its full-text Lelong-number section and does not state a radial mollifier formula. No numerical experiment is used.
scientific_limitations: The formula is restricted to radial averaging kernels centered at the singular point and assumes a finite logarithmic radius moment. It determines the limiting additive gap but not its convergence rate, and it does not address directional information carried by nonradial kernels.
title: A logarithmic-moment calculus for radial Lelong averages
